**Finding: compliant** (preferred position) — no redline proposed.

- **§ 12.3** expressly negates any restriction on our business: we remain free to develop, acquire, license, sell or use any product or service, engage any supplier, and operate in any field or territory, with confirmation that we made no exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, minimum-volume or no-hire commitment.
- **§ 2.1** reinforces this with no minimum quantity or purchase commitment, and confirms that declining further Order Forms is not a breach.
- The only competition-related restraints bind Brightline (**§ 12.4** — Vendor shall not develop or market a service competing with our analytics products during the term; **§ 24** — no assignment to a direct Customer competitor without consent). These benefit us and are correctly not flagged.

No field-of-use, territory, or post-term restraint on the customer appears anywhere in the document.
